en.hubeali: ‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘But rather, a Believer would be enjoined with the good and forbid from the evil, so he would heed advice, or if ignorant, so he would learn, and as for the owner of the whip or a sword, so no!’.
en.sarwar: 2. It is narrated from the narrator of the previous Hadith who has said the following:
“Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘Only believing people who accept good advice should be asked to do good and prohibit committing evil but not those who have the whip and the sword.’”
